name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2026-05-18, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.85 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
